text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан puts up a good race at the
Arima
Kinen, but she's no match for
Oguri Cap.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oguri recognizes Ryan's talent, however,
and
vows to face her again in the same
race next year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With this experience in hand, Mejiro
Ryan aims
for a rematch against Mejiro
McQueen with the
spring Tenno Sho
next in her sights!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
